import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
sleep_health = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Convert categorical variables to categorical data type
sleep_health['Gender'] = sleep_health['Gender'].astype('category')
sleep_health['Occupation'] = sleep_health['Occupation'].astype('category')
sleep_health['BMI Category'] = sleep_health['BMI Category'].astype('category')
sleep_health['Blood Pressure'] = sleep_health['Blood Pressure'].astype('category')
sleep_health['Sleep Disorder'] = sleep_health['Sleep Disorder'].astype('category')

# Create a boxplot to visualize the distribution of sleep duration by gender
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='Gender', y='Sleep Duration', data=sleep_health)
ax.set_title('Sleep Duration by Gender')
ax.set_xlabel('Gender')
ax.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.savefig('output1.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a bar chart to visualize the distribution of physical activity levels across different age groups
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x='Age', hue='Physical Activity Level', data=sleep_health)
ax.set_title('Physical Activity Levels by Age')
ax.set_xlabel('Age')
ax.set_ylabel('Count')
ax.legend(title='Physical Activity Level')
plt.savefig('output2.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
